cases.patient_profile: 58-year-old male diagnosed with metastatic non-small cell lung adenocarcinoma. Molecular testing confirms KRAS G12C mutation positive, PD-L1 TPS is 65%. Brain MRI reveals no evidence of brain metastases. Patient has received no prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease.

criteria.raw_text: Phase 2: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of unresectable or metastatic NSCLC with KRAS G12C mutation and any PD-L1 TPS
criteria.rationale: Patient has metastatic NSCLC with KRAS G12C mutation.

criteria.raw_text: Phase 3: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of unresectable or metastatic squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC with KRAS G12C mutation and PD-L1 TPS\>=50%
criteria.rationale: Patient has adenocarcinoma with KRAS G12C and PD-L1 TPS 65%, which satisfies >= 50%.

criteria.raw_text: Phase 3: Presence of measurable disease per RECIST1.1
criteria.rationale: Profile does not state whether measurable target lesions meet RECIST 1.1.

criteria.raw_text: No evidence of brain metastases
criteria.rationale: Brain MRI explicitly confirms no evidence of brain metastases.

criteria.raw_text: Phase 2 and Phase 3: Prior systemic treatment for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC including chemotherapy, immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, or a therapy targeting KRAS G12C mutation (e.g., AMG 510).
criteria.rationale: Patient has received no prior systemic therapy, so exclusion does not apply.

criteria.raw_text: Phase 2: Active brain metastases
criteria.rationale: Patient has no brain metastases.

cases.patient_profile: 54-year-old female diagnosed with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (ER-negative, PgR-negative, HER2-negative) with documented disease progression after 4 prior lines of systemic therapy. Echocardiogram demonstrates normal cardiac function with a baseline left ventricular ejection fraction of 58%, and she has no history of anthracycline use. Brain MRI confirms absence of brain or leptomeningeal metastases. Her last major abdominal surgery was performed 6 months ago.

criteria.raw_text: Female participants, 18 years or older
criteria.rationale: Patient is a 54-year-old female.

criteria.raw_text: Performance status 0 or 1
criteria.rationale: Performance status is not documented in the patient profile.

criteria.raw_text: Locally advanced or metastatic triple negative breast cancer (ER-negative, PgR-negative, and HER2-negative according to ASCO/CAP guidelines)
criteria.rationale: Patient has confirmed metastatic triple negative breast cancer.

criteria.raw_text: Disease progression after no more than 3 prior lines of therapy
criteria.rationale: Patient has received 4 prior lines of therapy, which violates the <=3 limit.

criteria.raw_text: Presence of metastases in the brain or cancer spreading into the cerebrospinal fluid - CSF (leptomeningeal disease)
criteria.rationale: Patient has no brain or leptomeningeal metastases.

criteria.raw_text: Major surgery within 4 weeks prior to first study treatment
criteria.rationale: Surgery was 6 months ago, outside the 4-week exclusion window.

criteria.raw_text: Participants who have previously received maximum cumulative lifetime anthracycline dosage or baseline ejection fraction \<50% (on heart echography)
criteria.rationale: Patient has LVEF 58% and no prior anthracycline exposure.

cases.patient_profile: 67-year-old male with chronic systolic heart failure, NYHA class III. Echocardiogram demonstrates a severely reduced LVEF of 28%. Baseline NT-proBNP is 1450 pg/mL with no history or findings of atrial fibrillation. Blood pressure is stable at 124/78 mmHg. Patient has no history of myocardial infarction, stroke, or major cardiovascular surgery.

criteria.raw_text: Male or female patient age \>= 18 years at screening. For Japan only: Age \>= 20 years at screening
criteria.rationale: Patient is a 67-year-old male.

criteria.raw_text: Patients with chronic HF (Chronic Heart Failure) NYHA (New York Heart Association Classification) class II-IV and reduced EF (Ejection Fraction) (LVEF (Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction) \<=40%) and elevated NT-proBNP (N-terminal of the prohormone brain natriuretic peptide)
criteria.rationale: Patient has NYHA III, LVEF 28% (<=40%), and elevated NT-proBNP.

criteria.raw_text: If EF\<= 30%: NT-proBNP \>= 600 pg/ml for patients without AF and NT-proBNP \>=1200 pg/ml for patients with AF
criteria.rationale: Patient EF is 28% (<=30%), has no AF, and NT-proBNP is 1450 pg/mL (>=600 pg/mL).

criteria.raw_text: Signed and dated written ICF (Informed Consent Form)
criteria.rationale: Written informed consent status is not documented in the patient profile.

criteria.raw_text: Myocardial infarction, coronary artery bypass graft surgery, or other major cardiovascular surgery, stroke or TIA (Transient Ischaemic Attack) in past 90 days prior to Visit 1
criteria.rationale: Patient has no history of MI, stroke, or CV surgery.

criteria.raw_text: Symptomatic hypotension and/or a SBP \< 100 mmHg
criteria.rationale: Patient blood pressure is 124/78 mmHg with no hypotension.
